content.text: Hi, please update the shipping address on ORD-1127. My email is yuki.sato@example.jp.

We need to verify identity. Customer provided email. Use lookup_customer. Then get order to verify belongs to that customer and check status (not shipped). Need new address details. The user hasn't provided new address. So we need to ask for new address details. According to policy, ask clarifying question. So we should first verify identity, then ask for new address. But we need to verify before acting. So first call lookup_customer with email.
